title: Organizer creates a Multi Round Robin
description: Create a Multi Round Robin: choose the format, select players one by one (with a note on repeating), set players per group, review rating-based groups, drag a player between groups when needed, and open the new compound event.

steps.title: Organizer on Players
steps.body: Multi Round Robin needs a larger field than a single table. The tutorial roster is large enough to form multiple groups.

steps.title: Start a tournament
steps.body: Open the type modal to pick Multi Round Robin instead of a single Round Robin.

steps.title: Tournament type modal
steps.body: Multi Round Robin sits alongside Round Robin, Playoff, Swiss, and Preliminary compounds.

steps.title: Choose Multi Round Robin
steps.body: Select Multi Round Robin to split the field into several rating-based Round Robin groups under one parent event.

steps.title: Multi Round Robin selected
steps.body: The format is highlighted. Optionally name the event, then continue to player selection.

steps.title: Continue to players
steps.body: Advance to the shared player picker. Multi Round Robin typically needs more players than a single table.

steps.title: Player selection
steps.body: Each row has a checkbox. Multi Round Robin needs enough members for at least two groups (six or more under default rules).
steps.resultNote: Wizard moved to the player selection step.

steps.title: Select a player
steps.body: Check one member to add them to the Multi Round Robin field. You will repeat this for everyone who should play.

steps.title: One player included
steps.body: That member is now counted in the selection total. Multi Round Robin still needs several more players before you can continue.
steps.resultNote: First checkbox applied; selection count increased by one.

steps.title: More selections work the same
steps.body: You can check several more players the same way. The next screen skips those repeated clicks and shows a full enough roster for multiple groups.

steps.title: Roster filled in
steps.body: After repeating the selection, enough members are checked for at least two Round Robin groups. Continue opens group configuration.
steps.resultNote: Multiple players selected behind the scenes (Select All is not required).

steps.title: Continue to group size
steps.body: Leave player selection and configure how many players go in each Round Robin group.

steps.title: Players per group
steps.body: Set the target group size. The summary shows how many groups rating-based splitting will create.
steps.resultNote: Multi Round Robin Configuration panel is open.

steps.title: Build groups
steps.body: Continue to preview the rating-based groups. Strongest players land in Group 1, then Group 2, and so on.

steps.title: Confirm groups
steps.body: Rating-based split is a starting point. Review each group before creating the event.
steps.resultNote: Confirm Groups step lists the proposed Round Robin tables.

steps.title: You can rearrange groups
steps.body: Drag a player from one group onto another when the automatic split is not what you want — for example to separate clubmates, balance tables, or move a junior. Each group must keep at least two players.

steps.title: Move a player between groups
steps.body: Drag this player onto Group 2 to apply that kind of adjustment.

steps.title: Groups updated
steps.body: That player now sits in Group 2. Each group must keep at least two players. Adjust further the same way until the field looks right.
steps.resultNote: One player moved from Group 1 to Group 2 via drag-and-drop.

steps.title: Continue to confirm
steps.body: When the groupings look right, continue to the final create confirmation.

steps.title: Confirm tournament
steps.body: Review type, total players, and group count, then create the Multi Round Robin parent event.
steps.resultNote: Final confirmation with Create Tournament is visible.

steps.title: Create the tournament
steps.body: Finalize creation. The app opens the new Multi Round Robin (parent) tournament page.

steps.title: Tournament page
steps.body: You land on the compound event with child Round Robin groups ready for day-of tools and scoring.
steps.resultNote: Create Tournament succeeded; detail page shows the Multi RR event.
